Description: WHO AFRO monthly regional cholera bulletin for March 2025 (the April 2025 bulletin, 10665/381653, reprints the same map). Country narrative: 'For the year 2025, as of 23 March, the cumulative number of cases reported from Togo was 165, and four deaths with a CFR of 2.4%. In March, new cases decreased by 93.1% from 72 in February to five... The current outbreak started on 27 July 2024.' Figure 28 is a district choropleth of Togo produced by WHO AFRO Health Information and Risks Assessment on 30 March 2025 from Ministry of Health Togo data. It labels EVERY Togolese health district and shades exactly THREE as affected - Agoe-Nyive (Grand Lome, 35.76-77.20% of the total, symbol class 70-149 confirmed cases), Golfe (Grand Lome, 14.52-35.75%) and Bas-Mono (Maritime, 14.51%) - with every other district in the legend category 'Non affected districts'. IMPORTANT LIMIT ON HOW FAR THIS MAP CAN BE READ: it is the position at its own data cut on the then-current reporting year, NOT a whole-outbreak statement. The August and September 2024 bulletins (10665/379287, 10665/379753) state 'The cases were reported from Vo and Golfe districts', yet Vo is unshaded here; and the February 2025 bulletin (10665/381148) reports the response evaluation being finalised 'in the Districts of Agoe, Bas Mono, and Lacs', yet Lacs is unshaded. Rows citing this source are therefore scoped to 1 January - 23 March 2025 only.

Source: ECDC Communicable Disease Threats Report, week 9 2026 - cholera worldwide section (NON-REPORTING CAVEAT, no row derived)
Description: REGISTERED AS A CAVEAT, NOT AS DATA - no observation row is derived from it, and none should be. Its cholera section states verbatim: "Since 28 January 2026, no updates have been reported by Cameroon, Chad, Comoros, Congo, Cote D'Ivoire, Ethiopia, Ghana, Kenya, Rwanda, South Sudan, Togo, Uganda, or the United Republic of Tanzania." READ THIS CAREFULLY BEFORE TRUSTING ANY 2026 TOGO ZERO: "no updates have been reported BY" is an absence of REPORTING, not an absence of disease - it is the Surveillance_Gap category, which is not a valid basis for a zero row. The list is proof of its own point: South Sudan, Chad, Congo, Cameroon and Ethiopia all appear in WHO's 2026 cholera tables WITH cases while sitting on this same "no updates" list. Consequences: (1) row Index 25 (2026-01-01..2026-03-29) is labelled Documented_Absence on the strength of Togo's non-appearance in WHO epidemiological update #36 - that label is TOO STRONG and should be downgraded to Inferred_Absence by whoever can edit it; (2) rows 335-338, added by Agent 3 for April-July 2026, deliberately use Inferred_Absence for exactly this reason and quote WHO's own footnote "Missing data in this report do not imply the absence of cholera or AWD cases or deaths in the respective country"; (3) what actually carries the 2026 Togo absence is not non-listing at all but the fact that Togo was concurrently notifying MEASLES to WHO AFRO through 19 July 2026, so the reporting channel was demonstrably live.
